parts.name: Handlebar & Hand Controls
parts.description: The tapered handlebar with grips, levers, mirrors and switchgear.
parts.function: The rider's steering input plus the throttle, clutch and front-brake controls.

parts.name: Handlebar
parts.description: A tapered handlebar. Its bend and dimensions in the 3D view are representative; overall width is bounded by Honda's 32.4 in vehicle width.
parts.function: Steering leverage and the mounting point for the hand controls.

parts.name: Throttle Grip
parts.function: Opens the throttle-body butterflies to control engine power.
parts.verificationNote: Throttle actuation type (cable or electronic) is not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

parts.name: Front Brake Lever
parts.description: The right-hand lever that operates the front brake master cylinder.
parts.function: Squeezing it pressurizes the front brake hydraulics.
parts.verificationNote: The part number and any adjustability are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

parts.name: Clutch Lever
parts.description: The left-hand lever that releases the clutch. Honda says the assist/slipper clutch reduces the effort needed in stop-and-go riding.
parts.function: Pulling it disengages the clutch so you can shift gears or stop without stalling.
parts.verificationNote: The part number and actuation are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

parts.name: Mirrors
parts.description: Left and right rear-view mirrors. Their shape is representative.

parts.name: Foot Controls
parts.description: Mid-mounted rider footpegs, the gearshift pedal (left) and the rear brake pedal (right).
parts.function: Rider support, and foot operation of gear changes and the rear brake.

oem.note: A PEDAL diagram is listed for 2026 Rebel 500 (SE listing).

parts.name: Rider Footpegs
parts.function: Support the rider's feet and put them within reach of the shift lever and brake pedal.

parts.name: Left Footpeg
parts.verificationNote: Mid-mount position is Honda-confirmed. The exact location and part number are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

parts.name: Right Footpeg
parts.verificationNote: Mid-mount position is Honda-confirmed. The exact location and part number are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

parts.name: Gearshift Pedal
parts.description: The left-foot gear lever. Six-speed pattern; the exact pattern is not yet verified here.
parts.function: Rotates the gearshift spindle and drum to select gears: press down or lift up one gear at a time.
parts.verificationNote: The part number and linkage are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

parts.name: Rear Brake Pedal
parts.description: The right-foot pedal that operates the rear brake master cylinder.
parts.verificationNote: The part number is not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.
